title: UserPromptSubmit hooks no longer redact Code Mode script output after 2.1.328
symptoms: Secrets or text that a UserPromptSubmit hook used to mask now appear in script output
Managed UserPromptSubmit hooks seem to be skipped for Code Mode scripts
cause: 2.1.328 stopped running UserPromptSubmit hooks, including managed ones, on the output of Code Mode scripts.
fix: Move the redaction to a PostToolUse hook that returns updatedToolOutput.
apply: Add a PostToolUse hook in settings.json that returns {"updatedToolOutput": "<redacted text>"}
affected: Claude Code 2.1.328 and later, Code Mode
